senses.gloss: (b. h.; Shaf. of חתם; cmp. סָתַם)to unseal, open, esp. to bore a hole through a vessel in order to get wine out by means of a tube.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:3">Ab. Zar. V, 3</cite>, sq. <he>כדי שיִשְׁתּוֹם ויסתום וכ׳</he> time sufficient to bore a hole, and close it again &c., v. <cite ref="N00115"><he>נָגַב</he></cite>; a. e.
